name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-12-01, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.07 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
